name: retry-exhaustion-test-pins-loop-boundary-counts
body: The exhaustion count assertion encodes the retry loop's read/sleep shape (reads = budget/step + 1, sleeps = budget/step); if `freshness_read_retry` ever changes how it lands exactly at the budget boundary, revisit `freshness_read_retry_exhausts_at_the_budget` (src/git/tests.rs:469) — upgrade when that loop's boundary semantics change.
